# Ghafric Bazaar UAE

> African body care sold online from Dubai. Every piece is 30 AED. Delivery anywhere in the UAE is 25 AED and takes 1 to 3 business days. From 7 through 14 November 2026, delivery is free only when the pieces add up to 150 AED. Under 150 AED, delivery stays 25 AED. After 14 November 2026, delivery is 25 AED. Cash on delivery adds 10 AED even when delivery is free.

Ghafric Bazaar has no stall at Global Village. It delivers African body care anywhere in the UAE. Order on WhatsApp or on the website.

## How to use Chebe

Chebe powder, and a Chebe mask or cream that stays on the hair, is for the hair lengths only. Mix it into oil or shea and work it through the lengths. It must not touch the scalp. Wash-off Chebe shampoo and conditioner can be used as a normal wash.

## Outside the UAE

Ghafric Bazaar delivers within the UAE. A buyer outside the UAE arranges the shipping onward. The shop can deliver to a courier station or any address the buyer gives, or the buyer can pick it up.
